record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, weaken only the existing training-frequency history scaling: change its exponent from -0.25 to -0.125, retaining mean-one normalization, clipping to [0.75,1.25], unseen-item scale one and padding scale zero. Gentler suppression may preserve useful frequent-item context while retaining modest frequency correction. Keep the projected standardized log-frequency feature and all learned modules unchanged; checkpoint and restore the revised scalars.
